Seminar Title:

FABRICATION, CHARACTERIZATION AND PERFORMANCE EVALUATION OF PARTICULATE FILLED MULTI-FIBER COMPOSITES

Seminar Type:

Registration Seminar

Department:

Mechanical Engineering

Venue:

06 Oct 2026 04.15 PM

Contact:

Alok Satapathy

Abstract:

This research includes a comprehensive study on mechanical, tribological and machining
characteristics of a new class of hybrid composites consisting of glass and aluminium fibers
along with different particulate fillers. Micro-sized titanium oxide, fly ash and bamboo dust
are the three different particles considered as the functional fillers in this work. It is proposed
to study the effect of the individual fillers on the composite characteristics. The initial
findings suggest that the physical and mechanical properties are substantially affected by the
presence of filler.
